name: Manual Trigger — Bug Fix Workflow (WF4)
description: Manually triggers the WF4 Autonomous Bug Fix workflow to investigate and fix bugs with regression tests

then.prompt: Execute the WF4 Autonomous Bug Fix workflow. Follow the wf4-bug-fix skill steps exactly: 1) Perform root cause analysis on the reported bug or failing test to identify the source of the defect. 2) Generate a code fix addressing the identified root cause. 3) Generate regression tests that verify the fix and prevent recurrence. 4) Perform side-effect analysis to verify the fix does not introduce new defects. 5) Run the fix validation checkpoint — if it fails, report the failure and halt. 6) Log all inputs, generated outputs, and checkpoint results to the audit-logger MCP. Create a restore point before applying the fix using git-rollback MCP create_restore_point.
